0022600030.text: The Toronto Raptors (4-3, on a one-game win streak) visit the Milwaukee Bucks (1-7, on a four-game losing streak) in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group A game, Toronto's ninth of the season, with the Raptors 3rd in the Atlantic and 4th in the East and the Bucks 5th in the Central and 15th in the East. Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), while Milwaukee is missing Kam Jones (ankle). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and the Raptors won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 122-94 win in Milwaukee on February 22, 2026.
